messages:
li: Heads up — found a regression when implicit routing coercion runs for /v2/generate vs /generate.
li: failing paths: client libs that send "model: 'gpt-4'" without explicit api_version header get coerced to v1 shape -> 400s.
anya: oof. repro steps?
li: curl example:
```
POST /generate
Content-Type: application/json
{"model":"gpt-4","prompt":"hi"}
```
li: response: 400 {"error":"missing 'messages' field for chat models"}
devin: so coercion expects different payload shape for legacy endpoints. That's by design but we should detect model/model-type earlier.
sam: is this about implicit routing that switches to tokenizer-compatible proxy? or the negotiation layer?
li: negotiation layer inserts a conversion that tries to map fields -> chat messages; it currently only runs when api_version header missing, but fails to recognize 'model' semantics for chat-first models.
anya: quick mitigation: add a lightweight sniff: if JSON has "prompt" and "model" in a chat model list -> treat as v2-generation candidate and run prompt->messages transform.
devin: feels hacky but low-risk. how about telemetry so we can count hits and owners can decide deprecation notices?
li: +1. add tag "implicit_coercion=v2_transform" to request metadata.
sam: longer term we should formalize "capability sniffing" boundaries in the handshake RFC. Don't want many heuristics.
product-kai: customers hit this in prod; want safe fallback now but a plan to push developers to set api_version explicitly. propose 2-week opt-in toggle for heuristic then warn-only for 30 days then remove.
anya: timeline seems fine. ops: can we gate via feature flag per-tenant?
devin: yes, feature-flagged in routing layer. also will add rate-limit to new transform to avoid overload.
li: I'll open a PR: add sniff logic + telemetry + feature flag toggle. Will include unit tests for message mapping and e2e with client SDK.
li: PR link when ready: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/12345
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: canary to staging tomorrow 09:00 UTC — tag: canary/implicit-coercion.
sam: add note to migrations doc + send email to customers who haven't pinned api_version.
product-kai: I'll draft the email.
anya: thanks — let's avoid another silent migration surprise.
devin: agree. after canary we'll collect metrics and decide whether to make opt-in default.
li: sounds good. tagging eng-runtime on PR review @sam @devin.
sam: on it :eyes:
